source_backfill.lede: Help us understand how you found Multica.

source.question: How did you hear about Multica?
source.other_placeholder: e.g. a podcast I listen to

cli_install.intro: You'll need an agent runtime on this computer (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, …) for it to run your agent. Also works on servers and remote dev boxes.

cloud_waitlist.intro_main: Cloud runtimes aren't live yet. Leave your email and we'll reach out when they are.
cloud_waitlist.intro_warning: Heads-up: agents can't start runs without a runtime — if you hit Skip now, nothing will run until you come back and install one.
cloud_waitlist.reason_placeholder: e.g. we want agents running 24/7, or my team works across different devices.
cloud_waitlist.success_toast: You're on the list. We'll email when cloud runtimes are live.

step_workspace.lede_first: A workspace is where your issues, agents, and projects live. You can invite teammates or spin up more workspaces later.
step_workspace.lede_resume: Resume setup with the workspace you already have, or create a new one alongside it — you can belong to any number of workspaces.
step_workspace.name_placeholder: Acme Inc, My Lab, Side Projects…
step_workspace.issue_prefix_suffix: . You can change this later in settings.
step_workspace.issue_prefix_pending: Set the URL above and issue numbers will follow it — or type a prefix here.
step_workspace.hint_name_first: Name your workspace to create it.
step_workspace.hint_pick: Pick your workspace or start a new one.
step_workspace.slug_format_error: Only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens
step_workspace.slug_taken_error: That workspace URL is already taken.
step_workspace.slug_reserved_error: That workspace URL is reserved and cannot be used.
step_workspace.creation_disabled_headline: Ask your administrator for an invitation.
step_workspace.creation_disabled_lede: This Multica instance does not allow new workspaces to be created. Once an administrator invites you to a workspace, accept the invitation and refresh to continue.
step_workspace.creation_disabled_lede_resume: Workspace creation is disabled on this instance, so you'll continue into your existing workspace.

welcome.headline: Your AI teammates, in one workspace.
welcome.lede: Hand tasks to agents the way you'd hand them to a colleague. They run on the coding tools and subscriptions you already have.
welcome.plan_connect_body: Agents run on a computer you own — the desktop app or a terminal command sets it up.
welcome.plan_tool_body: It becomes your first agent. Not installed yet? You'll see how to install it.
welcome.plan_task_body: One sentence is enough, optionally pointed at a project folder.
welcome.plan_watch_body: Progress, changes and results all stay on the task. Invite teammates whenever you're ready.
welcome.detected_none: No coding tools found on this computer yet. You can install one in the next step.

tool_picker.detecting: Looking for coding tools on this computer…
tool_picker.more_tools: OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Kimi and 20+ other tools are picked up automatically once installed.

install.title: Install {{name}}
install.description: Run these in a terminal on this computer. It signs in with your {{vendor}} account, so your agent works on your own subscription.
install.step_return_desktop: Come back and choose Check again — it shows up in the list.
install.step_return_web: Restart the daemon on that computer — it then shows up in the list

step_tool.title: Which coding tool should your agent use?
step_tool.description: It becomes your first agent, named after the tool, and works on your own subscription.
step_tool.description_empty: There's no coding tool on this computer yet. Install one you already pay for — it becomes your first agent.
step_tool.hint: Want more? Add agents any time from Agents.

step_first_task.title: Give {{name}} its first task
step_first_task.description: Write it the way you'd ask a teammate. You'll watch {{name}} work on it as it happens.
step_first_task.folder_failed: That folder can't be used. Pick another one.
step_first_task.suggestion_1: Draft a launch announcement for a new feature
step_first_task.suggestion_2: Compare three ways to structure a REST API
step_first_task.suggestion_3: Write a script that renames photos by date
step_first_task.suggestion_folder_1: Walk me through how this project is structured
step_first_task.suggestion_folder_2: Find and fix one small bug
step_first_task.suggestion_folder_3: Add install steps to the README
step_first_task.hint: Creates the task, assigns it to {{name}}, and opens it.

step_connect.title: Connect a computer
step_connect.description: Agents run on a computer you own, using the coding tools and subscriptions already on it.
step_connect.desktop_body: Everything included. It finds the coding tools on your computer by itself.
step_connect.terminal_body: For servers and remote dev boxes, or if you'd rather not install the app.
step_connect.waiting: Waiting for a computer to connect…

errors.setup_failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

getting_started.title: Get started
getting_started.agent_body: An agent is a coding tool on your computer that takes tasks.
getting_started.task_body: Write a task and assign it to an agent. Its progress, changes and results stay on the task.
getting_started.invite_body: It's just you here. Teammates can assign tasks, follow progress, and bring their own tools.
getting_started.github_body: Let agents open pull requests and link them to tasks.
getting_started.autopilot_body: Run a task on a schedule — a daily triage, a weekly report.

invite.title: Invite teammates
invite.description: They join as members: they can assign tasks to agents shared with them and add agents of their own.
invite.workspace_name_hint: Teammates see this name when they join.
invite.link_hint: Anyone with the link can join as a member for 7 days.
invite.seat_limit: There's no free seat for another member.

join.title: Bring your tools to {{workspace}}
join.description: Each agent runs on its owner's computer. Add a coding tool from this one as your own agent, or skip and use the ones shared with you.
